headline: 2 addresses catalogued (AIL token on BSC, initial token receiver); staking/farm contract and zkLink deployments not located

findings.text: D1: BscScan search surfaced AIL token at 0x66e3daa0c86e0ad56302d36af0e7c1ba24442244 on BSC (confirmed via CoinGecko and BscScan token page). No zkLink explorer is available in the DeFiPunkd-supported chain list; Bitcoin chain has no EVM contract explorer. No name-tag search was available for zkLink explorer.

D2: The official website (ailayer.xyz) was fetched; it links to stake.ailayer.xyz, claim.ailayer.xyz, and interaction.ailayer.xyz but no canonical 'deployed contracts' or 'addresses' documentation page was reachable or linked. protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc set to null.

D3: No audit links are recorded in protocol.audit_links. No audit PDFs were discovered via website or GitHub traversal. BscScan token page explicitly shows 'No Contract Security Audit Submitted'. This checklist item has no evidence and is recorded as an unknown.

D4: GitHub org AINNLayer2 has 5 repositories. Fetched AILAYER_mainnet_network_config (contains config.json — raw URL was blocked by allowlist). AILAYER_mainnet_deployment is a node-deployment repo, not a smart-contract deployment artifact repo. DefiLlama-Adapters is a fork with no AILayer-specific contract addresses in the root. No Foundry broadcast files, hardhat-deploy artifacts, or address tables were visible in the fetched repository pages.

D5: protocol.chains = [Bitcoin, zkLink]. Bitcoin has no EVM-compatible smart contracts. zkLink is not in the DeFiPunkd-supported chainId list (1, 10, 56, 130, 137, 324, 8453, 42161, 43114, 59144, 81457, 534352, 11155111). The AIL ERC-20 token was located on BSC (chainId=56) via CoinGecko/BscScan, but the protocol's on-chain surface appears to be primarily on the AILayer L2 chain itself (ANVM), which has a custom Blockscout explorer forked by AINNLayer2 but no publicly indexed address-tagged contracts were reachable in this run.
D6: No factory contract was discovered in D1–D4. This item is not applicable for this run.

D7: AIL token (0x66e3daa0c86e0ad56302d36af0e7c1ba24442244) classified as role=token, actor_class=unknown (no owner/admin in ABI — plain ERC20). Initial token receiver (0x99cf9CBC21DB2bF99eD84918915FAbe35cAAEf66) classified as role=other (treasury/initial holder candidate), actor_class=unknown.
D8: Both addresses in admin_addresses[] trace directly to the BscScan token page fetch (evidence[2]). CoinGecko provided a corroborating citation for the token address.

rationale.verdict: Corpus walked: ailayer.xyz website, github.com/AINNLayer2 org (5 repos), bscscan.com AIL token page, CoinGecko, DeFiLlama protocol page, BscScan constructor args. 2 addresses catalogued: the AIL ERC-20 token on BSC and its initial token receiver. The staking/farm contract(s), any zkLink or AILayer-L2 native contracts, and governance/admin multisigs were not located in this run due to: (a) no docs deployment page accessible, (b) GitHub raw config.json blocked by allowlist, (c) zkLink not in DeFiPunkd supported chains, (d) AILayer's custom L2 explorer not reachable as a pre-built surfacer URL.

evidence.shows: Official AILayer website — describes the protocol as an EVM-compatible Bitcoin L2 with AI-driven modular architecture; links to staking at stake.ailayer.xyz, claiming at claim.ailayer.xyz, and DApp center at interaction.ailayer.xyz

AILayer GitHub org has 5 public repos: AILAYER_mainnet_deployment (node deployment), AILAYER_mainnet_network_config (config.json), AILAYER_testnet_network_config, ail2-explorer (Blockscout fork), DefiLlama-Adapters fork. No smart-contract deployment artifact repos present.

AILayer Token (AIL) on BSC: 1B max supply, 1,278 holders, plain ERC-20 (no owner/admin functions), contract name AILayerToken, compiler v0.8.0, no audit submitted. Constructor args show initialSupply=1e27, receiver=0x99cf9CBC21DB2bF99eD84918915FAbe35cAAEf66.

CoinGecko confirms AIL contract address as 0x66e3daa0c86e0ad56302d36af0e7c1ba24442244; describes AILayer as a Bitcoin Layer 2 infrastructure chain with over 1M active addresses and $700M TVL supporting 100+ ecosystem projects.
DeFiLlama protocol page for ailayer-farm confirms category as Farm; TVL counting method: 'Staking tokens via AILayer Dataset counts as TVL'.
Repository contains README.md and config.json for ANVM (AILayer) mainnet network configuration. Raw URL of config.json was blocked by fetch allowlist so contract addresses within were not extracted.

D1: Bitcoin chain has no EVM contract explorer; zero addresses surfaced from Bitcoin chain

D4: AILAYER_mainnet_deployment repo content not fully inspected — may contain node operator addresses or genesis configuration with contract addresses
D5: AILayer L2 (ANVM) custom Blockscout explorer (ail2-explorer fork) URL not known/reachable; native L2 staking/farm contracts not discovered

D8: Address 0x99cf9CBC21DB2bF99eD84918915FAbe35cAAEf66 (initial AIL token receiver on BSC) — role unconfirmed; may be treasury, team wallet, or vesting contract; bytecode not inspected this run

protocol_metadata.about: AILayer is an EVM-compatible Bitcoin Layer 2 solution built on an AI-driven modular architecture, allowing users to stake AIL tokens to become PoS validator nodes and participate in AI model training reward programs. The protocol bridges Bitcoin mainnet assets to its ANVM (AILayer Network Virtual Machine) chain via Taproot threshold contracts and Tendermint consensus. Users can stake AIL tokens, earn validator and miner rewards, and access AI services via specialized subnets. TVL is counted as staked AIL tokens via the AILayer dataset.
